item.title: An executive flat in Ang Mo Kio just sold for $1.35 million – a record high despite remaining lease of 53 years
item.description: An executive HDB flat at 605 Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5 was just sold for $1.35 million ($705 psf), marking a new record high for such flats in Ang Mo Kio. This is despite the subject flat having a remaining lease of only 53 years, as its lease started in 1980. The short remaining lease could have been mitigated by the size of the flat, which measures a spacious 1,916 sq ft.
